name: Straco Corporation Limited
summary: Straco Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and management of tourism-related businesses in Singapore and China. It operates in two segments, Aquariums and Giant Observation Wheel (GOW). The Aquariums segment operates aquatic-related facilities and tourist attractions, including sea mammal performances. The Giant Observation Wheel segment operates circular giant observation structure, as well as provides commercial space. The company also operates cable-car facilities; and provides management and consulting services, and project management services for the company and third parties.
